as_told.title: The Vandenberg missile film in Alan Sandler's vault

plain: Film of an Atlas rocket launch at Vandenberg Air Force Base in California is said to show two discs flying around the rocket's tip. If it exists, it would be official footage of unknown craft. The investigator James Fox describes the film second-hand and links it to a man named Allan Sandler. The researcher Grant Cameron says he heard about it from Bob Emenegger, who worked with Sandler. Cameron dates the film to 1964 and says that when he asked where it was, Emenegger answered, "I don't think we sent that one back," and "I guess it's in Alan Sandler's vault," which Cameron places in Oregon.
